svg.aria-label: The Queen bee, in her crown and sash, holds up a scroll that reads <<<4, 256>>>: a launch of 4 blocks of 256 threads. Beside her a wooden board holds 4 comb frames, labelled block 0 to block 3, and on each frame rows of worker bees wait for the order. The Queen gives one order and every bee on every frame carries it out.
